manual:
Publishes the normal-network topology (every server your scripts have discovered, not the hidden darknet) plus your current city and connected host, refreshed continuously with no Singularity dependency at all - Known Servers, Rooted, Backdoored, and the map itself all stay live even with zero Source Files owned. Formulas Score controls whether node coloring/ranking uses precise Formulas.exe-based XP-per-second scoring or a rougher heuristic fallback when Formulas.exe isn't owned.

Actually connecting, traveling between cities, or opening a company location straight from the map all need Singularity access. The persistent Singularity worker now owns only company reputation/favor telemetry (33.70 GB at SF4.1 or 3.70 GB at SF4.3); direct, route, and hop commands use a transient 33.80/3.80 GB connect worker, while travel, location, and focused company-work commands use a transient 162.10/12.10 GB location worker. Actions queue serially through the network-child supervisor on any eligible rooted RAM host, expose waiting-for-RAM feedback in Last Navigation, and release that action RAM immediately after completion. Without Singularity, the map still shows you the way; it just can't walk it for you - Singularity Access reports whether it currently can.
